mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees with a bit of rain near Badger Prairie County Park, under a new moon.
Construction begins August 18 on Highway M, which will shift traffic lanes for about three weeks, and the Senior Center is currently seeking new volunteers who can commit to two shifts a month.
We have a packed schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, followed by live music at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
On Wednesday, August 5, police officers located and arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with the Devils Food Cake flavor of the day at Culvers, which remains open until 10 PM this evening.
